title: Trait
description: Big Five personality domains and their 30 facets, from the International Personality Item Pool (IPIP-NEO, public domain). Facet items are a measurement instrument (self-report questionnaire items for people), kept for evaluating trait expression; they are never rendered into prompts. Work styles reference the domains (higher-order crosswalk).

code.description: NEO code: domain letter, or letter and facet number (skos:notation)

domain.description: The facet's domain (skos:broader); null for a domain

neo_name.description: NEO-PI-R facet name the IPIP scale targets, where it differs from the IPIP label

items.description: IPIP-NEO 300 keyed items for the facet; in_120 marks the IPIP-NEO-120 (Johnson 2014) subset
